tbesh_html:
1) to tear away, seize, plunder, tear off, pull off, rob, take away by force
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to tear away, rob
1a2) to seize, plunder (with acc cognate)
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to be robbed
1b2) to be taken away

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to pluck off; specifically to flay, strip or rob
strongs_1890.kjv_def: catch, consume, exercise (robbery), pluck (off), rob, spoil, take away (by force, violence), tear.
